annotations.title: Find the best API for a task

description: Call this when a task needs an outside API or data source and you have not picked one, e.g. "search the web", "scrape this page to markdown", "get the BTC price", "Instagram comments for a post", "flight prices", "generate a PDF", "solve a captcha", "translate this text". Returns the recommended pay-per-call API with its price per call, reliability score and real usage, plus ranked alternatives and a link to each. Covers Web search; Web page extraction; LLM inference; Crypto prices & market data; On-chain data; People & company enrichment; Weather; News; Social media data; Job listings; Products & prices; Maps & places; Translation; Email, SMS & messaging; Flights & travel; Stocks & forex; PDF generation; Captcha solving; Sports data. Free, read-only and quick: it never calls or pays the APIs it describes.

max_price_usd.description: Budget per call in USD, e.g. 0.01

recent.description: true = only endpoints checked in the last 7 days

task.description: The job in plain words, as the user would put it, e.g. "scrape TikTok comments" or "weather forecast for a city"

name: find_best
title: Find the best API for a task
